dslRule:
<!id: add-null-check-before-getOriginalCu>
<!description: Adds a null check for the receiver expression before calling `getOriginalCu()` within a conditional expression, to prevent NullPointerExceptions. This rule applies when the receiver has no side effects and is of the specified type.>
<!severity: WARNING>
$receiver.getOriginalCu() == null :: hasNoSideEffect($receiver) && subtypeOf($receiver, "org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.refactoring.contentassist.CUPositionCompletionProcessor.CompletionContextRequestor")
=> $receiver == null || $receiver.getOriginalCu() == null
;;
summary: Adds a null check for the receiver of the `getOriginalCu()` method call within a conditional expression to prevent NullPointerExceptions, specifically targeting instances of `CUPositionCompletionProcessor.CompletionContextRequestor`.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
